title: 第四章 打脸第五章 大小姐第三更
content_zh:
“我……”
刚才天道图书馆震动，注意力都集中在识海了，现在还一片迷糊，而且，对方的拳法是啥都不知道，让他指点，指点个毛线啊！
“还请张老师指正！”
刘扬向前一步，躬身到底。
一侧的王颖也眨巴眼睛，想要看看自己刚认的这位“高人”如何指点。
“呃！”
见众人目光都集中过来，再不说话，只有丢人，张悬正想信口胡说，突然想起图书馆书籍中刘扬的缺点。
他并不知道上面记述到底是真是假，不过，现在这种情况，让他说其他的肯定也想不起来，只好硬着头皮：“你这套拳法，缺点很多，足有十二处！”
“哈哈，他说缺点很多，十二处？我没听错吧！”
“这是我听过最好笑的笑话！”
“这套飞花拳虽然级别不高，却是整个王国流传最广的一套拳路，也被称为基础拳，经过数千年前精简磨砺，虽不说完美无缺，缺点绝对是拳法中最少的，他居然说，有十二处？”
“信口雌黄，估计啥都没看出来，故意胡乱说的！”
……
周围众人，本以为他能说出什么，一开口顿时全都笑了起来。
飞花拳是天玄王国最基础的拳法之一，和地球上的太祖长拳一样，只要练功，基本都要学习，千百年来经过无数强者的磨砺，虽然威力不大，要说缺点之少，绝对是数得着，甚至还被人称为“无瑕之拳”。
如此拳法，这家伙居然一开口说有十二处缺陷……开什么玩笑！
别说一个师资考核零分的家伙，就算院长过来，也找不出这么多缺点吧！
“哦？张老师还真是大才，竟然能在飞花拳中看出十二处缺陷，我等愿闻其详！”
曹雄显然也没想到张悬如此浮夸，一开口就这样说，兴奋地眼睛放光，故意让他难堪。
将众人的对话听在耳中，张悬面容不变，心中却不由有些急躁，他怎么都没想到，这个叫刘扬的家伙，居然打出一个人人都知道的拳法！

换做前身，肯定也会知晓，关键是自己刚穿越不久，对方的记忆还没彻底融合！
不过，虽然前世只是个图书馆管理员，却不管怎么说都是穿越众，有着不一样的见识，再加上脸皮厚，眼皮一翻：“怎么，不相信？这不是我不指点，是你们不相信，不按我指点的做……这就怪不得我了！王颖，我们走，这种赌约，不赌也罢！”
“慢着，我们相信！还请指点吧！”
见他要走，曹雄急忙拦住。
他现在算是看出来了，对方是故意说出夸张的数据，让自己等人不以为然，然后好趁机溜走，不过，好不容易抓住机会教训他一顿，怎么可能放弃！
“这……”
见溜不掉，张悬只好将图书馆生成的书籍再次拿了出来。
“死就死吧！”
反正已经没了退路，眼睛落在书籍记载的缺点上，很快将十二处再次看了一遍，落到最后一个上，咬牙开口：“你刚才打的拳法是右路，我给个建议，你现在打左路，然后用左拳攻击石碑试试！”
既然是穿越者的福利，万一是正确的呢？再说就算不正确，现在也没其他办法了，反正他也想不出更好的说辞。
“打左路？”
“这尼玛也叫指点？”
“开什么玩笑，左手本来就没劲，打左路，不是把这套拳法打废了吗？”
……
众人先是一愣，随即哗然，一个个再次看向张悬，满是鄙夷。
左手力量比右手弱，这是人人都知道的，刘扬刚才打拳，风声呼啸，明显不是左撇子，现在让他打左路……开什么玩笑。
“刘扬，按照张老师说的试试，也好让他死心！”
曹雄显然没想到张悬会这样说，兴奋的快要跳起，口上却吩咐一句。
虽然是刚招收的学生，但他却十分清楚这位刘扬，一直擅长右手，并非左撇子，打左路，真要打下去，估计连30公斤都没有！
不指点能打出62公斤的拳力，指点后连30都打不出来，这一下这个张悬将会名声扫地，丢人现眼！

看他还能不能再像之前那么嚣张了！
“是！”刘扬也冷冷一笑，拳法再次施展。
他是不是左撇子知道的最清楚，让他打左路……真是胡说八道。
飞花拳是从小就练习的基础拳，左右颠倒虽然有些不习惯，很快还是适应过来，拳风猎猎，虽然看起来也是不错，但无论连贯还是力量，似乎都比刚才差了很多。
content_en:
"I..."
The library of Tiandao was shaking just now, and all the attention was focused on the sea of consciousness. Now it is still confused. Moreover, the opponent's boxing technique is unknown, so let him give you some guidance!
"Please correct me, Teacher Zhang!"
Liu Yang took a step forward and bowed to the end.
Wang Ying on one side also blinked, wanting to see what the "master" she had just recognized would say.
"Ugh!"
Seeing that everyone's eyes were focused on him, it would be embarrassing if he remained silent. Zhang Xuan was about to talk nonsense when he suddenly remembered Liu Yang's shortcomings in the library books.
He didn't know whether the above description was true or false, but in this situation, he couldn't remember anything else, so he had to bite the bullet and said, "This boxing technique of yours has many shortcomings, twelve in total!"
"Haha, he said there are many shortcomings, twelve? Did I hear it right?"
"This is the funniest joke I've ever heard!"
"Although this set of Feihua Fist is not of a high level, it is the most widely circulated set of boxing in the entire kingdom. It is also called the basic boxing. It has been streamlined and refined thousands of years ago. Although it is not perfect, it definitely has the least shortcomings among boxing techniques. He actually said, there are twelve?"
"You're talking nonsense, I guess you didn't see anything, you just said nonsense on purpose!"
…
Everyone around him thought he could say something, but they all laughed as soon as he spoke.
Feihua Fist is one of the most basic boxing techniques in the Tianxuan Kingdom. Like the Taizu Changquan on Earth, as long as you practice it, you must learn it. It has been tempered by countless strong men for thousands of years. Although it is not very powerful, it has very few shortcomings. It is even called the "Flawless Fist".
With such a boxing technique, this guy actually said he had twelve flaws... What a joke!
Not to mention a guy who got zero points in the teacher evaluation, even if the dean came here, he wouldn't be able to find so many shortcomings!
"Oh? Teacher Zhang is really a great talent. He can actually see twelve flaws in Feihua Fist. We are willing to hear the details!"
Cao Xiong obviously didn't expect Zhang Xuan to be so exaggerated. He said this as soon as he opened his mouth, his eyes shining with excitement, deliberately embarrassing him.
Listening to everyone's conversation, Zhang Xuan's face remained unchanged, but he couldn't help but feel a little impatient. He never expected that this guy named Liu Yang would actually perform a punch that everyone knew!
If he were his predecessor, he would definitely know it. The key is that he has just traveled through time and the other party's memory has not yet been completely integrated!
However, although he was just a librarian in his previous life, he still traveled through time and had different insights. In addition, he was thick-skinned and rolled his eyes: "What, you don't believe it? It's not that I don't give advice, it's that you don't believe it and don't do what I tell you... It's not my fault! Wang Ying, let's go, this kind of bet is not a bet!"
"Wait a minute, we believe it! Please give us some advice!"
Seeing that he was about to leave, Cao Xiong hurriedly stopped him.
He can now see that the other party deliberately told exaggerated data to make himself and others disapproval, and then took the opportunity to slip away. However, after finally seizing the opportunity to teach him a lesson, how could he give up!
"This..."
Seeing that he couldn't escape, Zhang Xuan had no choice but to take out the books generated by the library again.
"Just die!"
Anyway, there was no way out, and his eyes fell on the shortcomings recorded in the book. He quickly looked at the twelve points again, and settled on the last one. He gritted his teeth and said: "The punch you just punched was on the right. Let me give you a suggestion. Now hit the left, and then try attacking the stone tablet with your left fist!"
Since it is the welfare of time travellers, what if it is correct? Besides, even if it was incorrect, there was no other way now. He couldn't think of a better way to say it anyway.
"Play left?"
"Isn't this also called pointing?"
"Are you kidding? The left hand is already weak. If you hit it on the left, wouldn't it destroy this boxing technique?"
…
Everyone was stunned for a moment, and then started to uproar. They all looked at Zhang Xuan again, full of contempt.Everyone knows that the left hand is weaker than the right hand. Liu Yang was boxing just now and the wind was howling. He was obviously not left-handed. Now let him fight on the left... What a joke.
"Liu Yang, try as Teacher Zhang said, so that he can give up!"
Cao Xiong obviously didn't expect Zhang Xuan to say this. He was so excited that he almost jumped up, but he gave an order.
Although he is a newly recruited student, he knows very well that this Liu Yang has always been good at right-handedness and is not left-handed. If he really wants to play on the left, he will probably not even weigh 30 kilograms!
Without guidance, he can punch 62 kilograms, but with guidance, he can't even hit 30. Now Zhang Xuan will be disgraced and embarrassed!
Let’s see if he can be as arrogant as before!
"Yes!" Liu Yang also smiled coldly and used his boxing skills again.
He knows best if he's left-handed, and asking him to play left field... is bullshit.
Feihua Fist is a basic boxing that has been practiced since childhood. Although the left and right reversal is a bit unaccustomed, I quickly got used to it. Although the Fist Fist Hunting looks good, the consistency and strength seem to be much worse than before.
